topic: Myth: miners can spend the same coin twice
hook: Myth: a miner could spend the same bitcoin twice.

scenes.narration: Each full node independently validates blocks using the same consensus rules.
A block is only accepted if every transaction in it is valid and not already spent.
Doing lots of work does not let a miner skip those checks. A bad block is simply refused.

cta: Did that make sense? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
title: Myth: Can Bitcoin Miners Spend a Coin Twice?
description_body: Full nodes reject any block containing an already-spent transaction.
